page.layout: One page of text, centred; a library stamp in the lower centre (not transcribed).

main_text.head: HOC VOLVMINE CONTINENTVR.
main_text.p: DE PVLSIBVS libellus, ex Galeni libris collectus ac veluti in formulam redactus authore quidem incerto, sed diligentissimo doctissimoq;.
DE IVDICIIS vrinarum tractatus ex probatissimis collectus authoribus, & in tabulæ formam confectus, adiectis etiam causis, quæ hanc vel illam vrinam reddant, IO. VASSÆO Meldensi authore.
MORBORVM internorum prope omnium curatio, breui methodo comprehensa, ex Galeno præcipuè et Marco Gattinaria, per IAC. SYLVIVM medicum selecta.
DE RATIONE VICTVS in febribus secundum Hippocratem, in genere et singillatim libri III. authore BRVDO LVSITANO medico.
Cum elencho duplici, altero capitum, eo ordine quo in singulis libris deinceps consequuntur, altero alphabetico.

page.notes: The stamp reads "Medizinische Bibliothek Basel" (partly illegible). Some words in the printed text are in italic and spaced capitals; the line "SYLVIVM" and "VASSÆO" are rendered as printed in the scan with long s forms normalised.
